text: ぐんたいに　いた　ころは　マチス　しょうさに　ビシ！

structure.jp: ぐんたいに　いた　ころは
structure.en: back when I was in the army

structure.jp: マチス　しょうさに

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ぐんたいに　いた　ころ
patterns.explanation: A short sentence placed right before a word describes that word. Here 'I was in the army' describes 'time'. ぐんたいに いた ころ = 'the time when I was in the army'.
